title: Semantic entailment and scientific-claim admission validator v0
problem: Blocked by ticket-417. Quote-span validation proves that words occur in a chunk but not that the structured claim is entailed, authored as a finding, or correctly scoped. A second-pass admission validator must fail closed on bibliography, methods, cited background, speculation, and semantic mismatch.
acceptance_criteria: The validator evaluates entailment against the exact quote plus bounded same-section context and returns accepted, rejected, or needs_review with stable reason codes.
Validation distinguishes author finding, cited background, method/procedure, hypothesis, speculation, bibliography/title, and non-content text using domain-neutral contracts.
A model reviewer can only propose a structured decision; Python validates the decision and applies lifecycle policy.
Default tests and golden tests use deterministic mock reviewer outputs and never require Ollama, network, or a paid provider.
Optional live local review requires existing live-LLM gates and records model identity and prompt-contract version privately.
All bibliography, challenge, redirect, navigation, and quote/claim mismatch benchmark candidates produce rejected or needs_review decisions, never accepted.
On completion, ticket-419 changes from blocked to ready; no later Phase 4 ticket is activated.
test_plan: With mock-only env: python -m pytest tests/golden -q
With mock-only env: python -m rge.cli verify --skip-site
non_goals: Do not use the semantic reviewer as the sole authority for acceptance.
Do not weaken exact quote, offset, scope, domain, or prompt-injection checks.
Do not make live model review a CI requirement.
Do not add retrieval or public answer generation.
rollback_plan: Disable the semantic-review stage behind its runtime policy and route new uncertain candidates to needs_review. Retain decisions and do not bulk-promote candidates under rollback.
